page_title: TUN 1-0 FRA | Tunisia v France 30/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' The France players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+10' The France players halt their celebrations as referee Matthew Conger makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Goal! Antoine Griezmann (France) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Aymen Dahmen. He makes it 1:1.
90+8' Kylian Mbappe (France) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+6' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (France) is intercepted by the defence.
90+6' Kylian Mbappe (France) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. France win a corner.
90+6' The ball is cleared after Wajdi Kechrida (Tunisia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+4' Ousmane Dembele (France) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+4' It looks like Issam Jebali (Tunisia) saw red with that tackle. Matthew Conger won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+4' France work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Kylian Mbappe (France) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. France force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Kylian Mbappe (France) on the edge of the box.
90+2' Ghaylen Chaaleli (Tunisia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matthew Conger blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for France.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 43627.
